campus: Centre Superior de Música del Liceu, Barcelona (presencial)
university_awarding: NONE — and correctly so. No university is involved: this is a conservatory-sector official title. The awarding centre is the Centro Privado Autorizado de Enseñanzas Superiores de Música «Liceu» de Barcelona, and the title is homologated by the Ministerio de Educación by BOE order. Absence of a university is NOT a defect here — Enseñanzas Artísticas Superiores are a parallel official branch of Spanish higher education, not a sub-university one.
institution_type: conservatory (enseñanzas artísticas superiores) — specifically a CENTRO PRIVADO AUTORIZADO de enseñanzas superiores de música, i.e. privately run but state-authorised, not a public conservatory
official_status: OFICIAL — Máster en Enseñanzas Artísticas. Homologated by Orden ECD/765/2015, de 20 de abril (BOE-A-2015-4712), «por la que se homologa el plan de estudios del Título de Máster en enseñanzas artísticas en Interpretación de Ópera del Centro de Enseñanzas Superiores de Música “Liceu” de Barcelona». The Ministry's own register (infoartisticas.gob.es) lists it as one of five homologated Liceu masters.
ruct_code: BOE:BOE-A-2015-4712 — NOT IN RUCT, AND THAT IS EXPECTED. RUCT holds university titles only; Máster en Enseñanzas Artísticas sits in a separate official register. Absence from RUCT is not evidence against officiality here.
meces_level: MECES 3 — stated explicitly by the Ministerio de Educación, Formación Profesional y Deportes on its infoartisticas register page for másteres en enseñanzas artísticas de música
eqf_level: EQF/EHEA level 7 — MECES 3 maps to EQF 7 (second cycle)
europe_recognition: EHEA level 7 (Bologna) — academic recognition across the EHEA. This is a fully official Spanish higher-education title at MECES 3 / EQF 7, inside the Bologna framework; the Liceu's own FAQ states it gives «una titulación oficial de Máster de acuerdo con el Espacio Europeo de Educación Superior, reconocida por el Real Decreto 1614/2009». Evidence is the BOE homologation order, not a RUCT row. ⚠️ Two honest limits: (1) EHEA recognition is academic, not professional — a regulated profession would run through Directive 2005/36/EC and a separate national process; (2) recognition abroad still requires the receiving country's own procedure — Bologna makes it routine, not automatic.
diploma_supplement: YES — RD 1614/2009 provides for the Suplemento Europeo al Título for official enseñanzas artísticas superiores titles; NOT separately confirmed on the Liceu page itself
phd_access: NOT FOUND for this specific title — RD 1614/2009 masters in enseñanzas artísticas are MECES 3, and doctoral access for this branch runs through convenios with universities rather than automatically. The Liceu page does not state doctoral access, so do not assume it.
tuition_eu_eur: EUR 4,700 for the full 60-ECTS programme (rates as published for the January 2026 intake). Arithmetic: 4,700 / 60 = 78.33 EUR per ECTS, but the school publishes the total, not a per-credit rate.
tuition_non_eu_eur: NOT FOUND — the page publishes one figure with no nationality or residency differential. As a private authorised centre setting its own prices, one flat rate is the likely reality, but the page does not say so, so this is NOT FOUND, not «no surcharge».
tuition_year_of_rates: January 2026 intake (the most recent published cycle)
fees_extra_eur: NOT FOUND — no separate enrolment, audition or insurance fee published
language_of_instruction: English, Spanish and Catalan. The FAQ states verbatim: «Las clases colectivas pueden ser en catalán o castellano, idiomas oficiales en Cataluña, o inglés.» So Spanish is not strictly required for all teaching, but Catalan may be used.
start_month: January — this master runs January to May, unlike the other Liceu masters which run October to May
notes: THE ONLY EHEA-RECOGNISED QUALIFICATION IN THIS BATCH. ⚠️ But two things make it a poor fit for this candidate and must not be buried: (1) ADMISSION. The Liceu FAQ states that to obtain the OFFICIAL title an applicant must hold «el Título superior, Licenciatura de Música o equivalente» or demonstrate equivalent technical and musical competence; those who cannot receive a título propio diploma instead. This is stricter than the general rule in art. 15 RD 1614/2009 (which admits the holder of any official Grado) — log as a CONFLICT between the general regulation and the centre's own published condition, and treat the centre's statement as the operative one until confirmed with admissions. A software-engineering graduate could therefore end up with the non-official version of the same course. (2) SUBJECT. This is an opera-singing performance master for young classical singers, selected by audition; a producer/DJ portfolio does not satisfy that prueba de acceso. It is in this dataset because it is a January-start music master, not because it is reachable. Published admission cycle for the Jan-2026 intake: applications May–September 2025, selection October, enrolment and payment October–November 2025 — so for a January-2027 or 2028 start expect applications to close around the preceding September.

university_awarding: NONE — no university awards this, and none ever could. This is not a university qualification. institution_type: private school (not a university) — an authorised centro de Formación Profesional
official_status: OFFICIAL, BUT IN THE FP REGISTER, NOT THE UNIVERSITY ONE. Established by Real Decreto 566/2024, de 18 de junio (BOE-A-2024-12503), which creates the «Curso de especialización de Formación Profesional de Grado Superior en Desarrollo de aplicaciones en lenguaje Python». Spanish law does call the resulting title a «Título de Máster de Formación Profesional» — that wording is the source of the confusion, and it is NOT a university master's degree.
ruct_code: NONE — and correctly so: RUCT registers university titles only. Not a defect, but also not a substitute; officiality here rests on RD 566/2024.
meces_level: NOT IN MECES. The Ministry's TodoFP catalogue levels it at MECU 5C (Marco Español de Cualificaciones) and ISCED/CINE-11 P-5.5.4. MECES is the higher-education sub-framework whose level 3 is the master's level; this title is not in it.
eqf_level: EQF level 5 (short-cycle / advanced-technician level), per its MECU 5C classification. It is emphatically NOT EQF 7.
europe_recognition: NOT a master's degree in the EHEA sense, and this is the single most important thing to record about it. It is a genuine, official Spanish qualification — but it sits at EQF 5 (MECU 5C, ISCED 5.5.4), two full levels below a master's, and it lives in the vocational-training track, not the Bologna higher-education track. There is no Diploma Supplement and no doctoral access. Within the EU it travels through the vocational-recognition and EQF-transparency machinery (and DIGITECH's claim that its titles are «válidos en todo el territorio nacional y la Unión Europea» rests on that, not on Bologna) — which supports labour-market portability, NOT academic recognition as a second-cycle degree. Anyone comparing this line against a Máster Universitario is comparing an EQF 5 qualification with an EQF 7 one.
diploma_supplement: NO — the Suplemento Europeo al Título attaches to higher-education titles; FP uses the Europass certificate supplement instead

The only euro figure on the page is the enrolment deposit: «Python Barcelona · Curso de especialización · Matrícula: Pagar Matrícula Ahora 400€ · Financiación sin intereses». The price section says only «todo a un precio competitivo» and directs the applicant to admissions. EUR 400 is a matrícula, NOT the tuition — do not read it as the course price.
tuition_non_eu_eur: NOT FOUND — no price at all is published, so no differential can be checked either way
tuition_year_of_rates: NOT FOUND (the 400 EUR matrícula is undated; convocatoria 26/27 is the open cycle)
fees_extra_eur: EUR 400 matrícula (enrolment), interest-free instalments offered; scholarships («becas DIGITECH») said to be available in specific periods
modality: online (live classes via Aula Virtual, 85 of the 430 hours). Sibling DIGITECH masters in Ciberseguridad and IA y Big Data also run presencial (Málaga, Barcelona) and semipresencial (Madrid).
language_of_instruction: NOT FOUND — no explicit statement; the centre, its site and the FP curriculum are Spanish, but that is inference
start_month: CONFLICT — the blog post given as the source announces a FEBRUARY 2026 convocatoria, while the programme page itself now advertises «CONVOCATORIA 26/27 ABIERTA · Inicio 10/2026» (October 2026). Record both; DIGITECH clearly runs more than one intake a year but no 2027 dates are published.
notes: DURATION AND ACCESS BOTH MATCH THE OFFICIAL CURRICULUM: 430 hours over 5 months, exactly the figure in the Ministry's TodoFP catalogue for this curso de especialización — a good sign that DIGITECH is delivering the real regulated title rather than a look-alike. ⚠️ ACCESS IS THE BLOCKER FOR THIS CANDIDATE. RD 566/2024 admits only holders of specified Spanish Técnico Superior titles (DAW, DAM, ASIR, Sistemas de Telecomunicaciones e Informáticos, Mecatrónica Industrial, Automatización y Robótica Industrial, Mantenimiento Electrónico, Sistemas Electrotécnicos y Automatizados, Sistemas de Instalaciones Térmicas y de Fluidos, Electromedicina Clínica), and DIGITECH reproduces that list as «Acceso directo». A 300-ECTS Tunisian engineering degree is not on it; a university degree is not an access route to a curso de especialización at all. Entry would require homologating to a Spanish Técnico Superior, which is a downward equivalence. For a candidate who already holds a 5-year engineering degree this is a step DOWN in level, not a master's.
